args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export not sending the first week's report
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Investigate and fix the issue where a weekly scheduled export created early in the day does not send the report for that initial week. Propose adjusting the calculation for the next run time in the weekly cadence case to ensure the first scheduled export runs on the expected day, not one week later.
